# David Coleman — Director, Emergency Services

- **Relationship:** Diane's direct report; runs the Emergency Department across the system,
  based at the flagship. **This is the ED David** — not
  [David Reinhart](david-reinhart.md), the CFO.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1; daily during Epic stabilization.
- **What he owns:** [ED Throughput Improvement](../projects/ed-throughput.md); the ED side of
  Epic go-live.

## How to work with him
- Operationally sharp, runs hot in a crisis; give him clear priorities and air cover.
- His #1 blocker is **inpatient boarding** — the fix is upstream (bed flow + the bed-management
  Epic module), not in the ED itself.
- Manages charge-nurse lead [Latisha Brooks](latisha-brooks.md).

## Sensitivities
- Was passed over for a VP title last cycle and is a **flight risk** — retention conversation
  is pending with HR.
